engineering_gate_only: Native independent validation and measured memory headroom; no test metric gates or scientific budget changes.
historical_results: Old scores and artifacts are retained; these retraining results are separate, not recovered historical weights.
historical_source_binding: Available archived snapshot, not proved identical to historical executed source.
